desc: Hmm... while the top panel is wholesome, the bottom panel might be tricky? Chimi didn't seem to know what's inside the pyramid. But then, she knows that this "altar" has a master. So she's always known it as a shrine to Iwanaga and Asama, but not as a Lunarian facility? But then again, she didn't know that the shrine is the reason why the Holy Ground is the way it is... did she?
